cohort: 3,522 Black and White pregnant patients with non-anomalous singleton or twin gestations diagnosed with a hypertensive disorder of pregnancy at a single tertiary healthcare system between 2014 and 2020
finding: Black patients had higher odds of severe hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, preterm delivery (especially <34 weeks), classical cesarean delivery, severe maternal morbidity, and small for gestational age neonates compared to White patients.
mod_finding: Black patients had a higher aOR of classical cesarean delivery compared to White patients.
